editorNote: Peninsula Fresh Organics describes its farming business at 6 Henderson Road, Baxter. Its affiliated Peninsula Organic Farmgate retail store is a separate entity at 94 Baxter-Tooradin Road, Baxter. The previous listing mixed the two operations and labelled the location as Mornington. We have paused this recommendation while the correct visitor listing and place record are reconciled. This pause is not a closure claim.
